reverse.target: infrastructure-specification §B.1 - the 0002 migration refuses to run against the skeleton seed's shape. That is a DEPLOY-STOPPING failure by design: recoverable, loud, and before any data is altered. Recorded as an ordering in the deploy steps rather than left to the runbook, because the operator cannot infer from 'migration failed' that the remedy is deleting seed ROWS before the script.

infrastructure-specification §C.1 - downgrade() CANNOT reverse the fold: two rows collapsed into one and which row the guardian came from is gone. A downgrade that appears to work while losing guardian links would be reached for exactly when care matters most, so it raises and names the dump instead.
